title: Top Notch Service
text: This was an amazing tour. The driver was not a “guide” per se as that is not what we requested. We were a large family of 16 people who wanted a driver to show them the city for the day. Our driver did just that. Although he wasn’t considered a “guide,” he had numerous recommendations for places to see. The bus was cool and comfortable and the driver was extremely accommodating. I would definitely book this tour again with this company. It was top notch service.
author: Krystal_H

title: Outstanding experience!!
text: Outstanding experience!! Our party of 15 was treated to a wonderful half-day tour of beautiful Barcelona by Joan! Joan was extremely friendly and professional. He explained the beautiful features of the city. His love for Barcelona was apparent! His enthusiasm was contagious. We cannot wait to return to Barcelona and will certainly book again! Thank you for an amazing experience, Joan!!
